He also represents the [[Ukraine national basketball team|Ukrainian national basketball team]]. ==Professional career== Kravtsov played in the Ukrainian basketball league for [[BC Kyiv]] from 2005 to 2010. Kravtsov declared for the [[2009 NBA draft]], but after not being selected by a team, he returned to Kyiv to play one additional season. In July 2010, he joined the [[Boston Celtics]] for the 2010 [[NBA Summer League]].[http://www.masslive.com/sports/index.ssf/2010/07/boston_celtics_2010_orlando_su.html Boston Celtics 2010 Orlando Summer League roster announced, includes UMass grad Tony Gaffney] He then joined [[BC Donetsk]], for which he played from 2010 to 2012. On 14 July 2012, Kravtsov signed with the [[Detroit Pistons]].[http://www.nba.com/pistons/news/detroit-pistons-sign-center-viacheslav-kravtsov Detroit Pistons Sign Center Viacheslav Kravtsov] On 31 July 2013, Kravtsov was traded, along with [[Brandon Knight (basketball)|Brandon Knight]] and [[Khris Middleton]], to the [[Milwaukee Bucks]] in exchange for guard [[Brandon Jennings]].{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/bucks/release/bucks-acquire-knight-middleton-and-kravtsov-pistons|title=Bucks Acquire Knight, Middleton and Kravtsov from Pistons|date=31 July 2013|work=NBA.com|publisher=Turner Sports Interactive, Inc|access-date=2 August 2013}} On 29 August 2013, Kravtsov and [[Ish Smith]] were traded to the [[Phoenix Suns]] in exchange for [[Caron Butler]].[http://www.nba.com/suns/news/suns-trade-kravtsov-smith-bucks Suns Trade for Kravtsov, Smith From Bucks] On 1 March 2014, he was waived by the Suns.[http://www.nba.com/suns/news/suns-sign-randolph-waive-kravtsov Suns Sign Randolph, Waive Kravtsov] On 16 September 2014, he signed with the [[Foshan Dralions]] of China for the [[2014–15 CBA season]].[http://www.sportando.com/en/world/asia/134820/slava-kravtsov-signs-in-china-with-foshan-long-lions.html Slava Kravtsov signs in China with Foshan Long Lions] In July 2015, he joined the [[Milwaukee Bucks]] for the 2015 Las Vegas Summer League.{{cite news|title=Bucks Announce 2015 Summer League Roster|url=http://www.nba.com/bucks/release/bucks-announce-2015-summer-league-roster|access-date=1 October 2015|work=NBA.com|date=1 July 2015}} On 30 September 2015, Kravtsov signed a short-term contract with [[PBC CSKA Moscow|CSKA Moscow]], in order to replace injured [[Joel Freeland]].{{cite news|title=Viacheslav Kravtsov joined CSKA|url=http://www.cskabasket.com/news/?id=14645&lang=en|access-date=30 September 2015|work=cskabasket.com|date=30 September 2015|archive-date=1 October 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151001065117/http://www.cskabasket.com/news/?id=14645&lang=en|url-status=dead}} On 26 December 2015, he signed with the Spanish club [[Basket Zaragoza 2002|CAI Zaragoza]] for the rest of the season.{{cite news|title=Viacheslav Kravtsov, un refuerzo de lujo para la pintura del CAI Zaragoza|url=http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=118891|access-date=29 December 2015|work=acb.com|date=26 December 2015|language=es}} He averaged 11.1 points and 6.5 rebounds at the [[2015–16 Eurocup Basketball|Eurocup]] and 8.4 points and 5.4 rebounds at the [[2015–16 ACB season|Liga ACB]]. He came back to Spain on 18 October 2016 to sign with [[Valencia BC|Valencia Basket]].{{cite web|url=http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=126625|work=acb.com|date=18 October 2016|access-date=18 October 2016|language=es|title=Valencia BC alcanza un acuerdo con Kravtsov para lo que resta de temporada}} On 30 June 2017, Valencia announced that they did not renew their contract with Kravtsov.[http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/spain/239150/valencia-basket-parts-ways-with-slava-kravtsov-and-mike-tobey.html Valencia Basket parts ways with Slava Kravtsov and Mike Tobey] On 22 July 2017, Kravtsov signed with Turkish club [[Eskişehir Basket]] for the 2017–18 season.[http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/turkey/241986/eskiehir-basket-inks-with-slava-kravtsov.html Eskişehir Basket inks with Slava Kravtsov] On 19 July 2018, Kravtsov signed a one-year deal with [[CB Miraflores|San Pablo Burgos]] of the [[Liga ACB]].{{cite news |title=La experiencia de Viacheslav Kravtsov llega al San Pablo Burgos - Club Baloncesto San Pablo Burgos |url=https://www.sanpabloburgos.com/la-experiencia-viacheslav-kravtsov-llega-al-san-pablo-burgos/ |access-date=19 July 2018 |work=Club Baloncesto San Pablo Burgos |date=19 July 2018 |language=es-ES}} He spent the 2019–20 season in Japan with [[San-en NeoPhoenix]], averaging 13.8 points and 7.5 rebounds per game. On September 3, 2020, Kravtsov signed with [[BC Dnipro|Dnipro]] of the [[Ukrainian Basketball SuperLeague]].{{cite web |title=Slava Kravtsov signs with BC Dnipro |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/slava-kravtsov-signs-with-bc-dnipro/ |website=Sportando |access-date=September 3, 2020 |date=September 3, 2020}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA player statistics legend}} ===NBA=== ====Regular season==== {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | align="left" | {{nbay|2012}} | align="left" | [[2012–13 Detroit Pistons season|Detroit]] | '''25''' || 0 || '''9.0''' || '''.717''' || .000 || .297 || '''1.8''' || '''.4''' || '''.2''' || '''.4''' || '''3.1''' |- | align="left" | {{nbay|2013}} | align="left" | [[2013–14 Phoenix Suns season|Phoenix]] | 20 || 0 || 3.0 || .513 || .000 || '''.500''' || .9 || .1 || .0 || .1 || 1.0 |-class="sortbottom" | align="left" | Career | align="left" | | 45 || 0 || 6.3 || .672 || .000 || .333 || 1.4 || .2 || .1 || .2 || 2.2 {{S-end}} ==International career== In 2013, Kravtsov helped the [[Ukraine national basketball team|Ukrainian national basketball team]] qualify for their first [[2014 FIBA Basketball World Cup|FIBA World Cup]] since the break-up of the [[Soviet Union]] by leading everyone in the [[EuroBasket 2013|2013 EuroBasket tournament]] in blocks made with an average of two blocks per game.
